name: approval-flow
description: Phones the approver for a keypad OK before Claude makes creative or irreversible video-editing decisions (cuts, deleting footage, final exports, publishing), with a safety gate that blocks risky commands until approved. Built for Hyperframes projects.

editor_name.title: Your first name
editor_name.description: The approver hears this on the call, for example: Approval request from Priya's video edit.

approver_phone.title: Approver's phone number
approver_phone.description: The phone that rings for approvals. Include the plus sign and country code, no spaces. Your admin gives you this.

bird_caller_id.title: Caller ID number
bird_caller_id.description: The number the call comes from. Plus sign and country code, no spaces. Your admin gives you this.

bird_api_key.title: Bird API key
bird_api_key.description: Starts with bk_. Your admin gives you this. It is stored privately and never shown to Claude.

bird_api_url.title: Bird API address
bird_api_url.description: Leave as it is unless your admin tells you otherwise.
